seed_all_rng: set the random seed for torch numpy and python RNGs with a given integer or auto-generate one
setup_environment: perform environment setup work including library configuration and optional custom module loading via DETECTRON2_ENV_MODULE
setup_custom_environment: load and run a custom environment setup module by importing a Python file or module name
fixup_module_metadata: fix the __qualname__ of module members so sphinx can find them during documentation building
import_file: dynamically import a Python module given its full file path and optionally make it importable via sys.modules
